lines.text: ¿Sabías que tu teléfono nació en una hoja de papel?
lines.twist: a vintage rotary telephone grows out of a folded sheet of graph paper like a flower, in front of the red circle
lines.moment: the telephone pops up out of the paper sheet and bobs

lines.text: En 1936, Alan Turing imaginó una máquina hecha de una cinta y unas pocas reglas.
lines.twist: a 1930s man in a tweed suit whose head is a spool of paper tape; the tape unrolls across the page in a long strip of empty squares
lines.moment: the man rises in; the tape strip slides across

lines.text: En la guerra, sus máquinas ayudaron a descifrar Enigma, el código secreto nazi.
lines.twist: a vintage cipher machine with rotors opens like a birdcage and its round typewriter keys fly out like a flock of birds
lines.moment: the machine drops in with a thud; the keys flutter up

lines.text: Después se hizo una pregunta enorme: ¿puede pensar una máquina?
lines.twist: a classical marble bust whose head is replaced by an open clockwork of brass gears, with gears floating above it
lines.moment: the bust rises; the floating gears pop in one by one

lines.text: Su país lo condenó por ser homosexual. Murió con solo 41 años.
lines.twist: an empty vintage wooden chair with a single white lily on the seat, under a small cut-out grey rain cloud
lines.moment: the cloud drifts in from the side and hovers over the chair

lines.text: Hoy, cada pantalla que tocas sigue sus reglas.
lines.twist: a hand from a vintage photograph touches the screen of a 1950s television set; a paper tape strip flows out of the screen and loops around the red circle
lines.moment: the television pops in; the hand swings in to touch it
